basic_details.job_title: IIIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Assistant Engineer, Technical Superintendent and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad (IIIT Allahabad) has invited suitable internal candidates for 4 promotional posts in its administrative and technical cadre: Assistant Engineer (Electrical) (1), Technical Superintendent (2) and Superintendent (1), all at Pay Matrix Level-7. Applications must be submitted by hand to the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, on or before 15 December 2026, till 05:00 PM; applications received after the closing date and time will be summarily rejected.

Any candidate found ineligible at any stage is disqualified, and hiding or false information leads to cancellation of candidature at any stage. The Institute reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. Incomplete applications and applications without relevant supporting documents will be summarily rejected. No extension or late submission will be entertained. Preference will be given to Persons with Disabilities (PwD), even where reservation is not indicated, provided suitable PwD candidates are available and meet the eligibility criteria. The Institute reserves the right to assign or transfer the selected candidate to any section, department or office within the Institute. content_sections.heading: About IIIT Allahabad
content_sections.text: IIIT Allahabad is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance declared under an Act of Parliament to provide for education and research in IT-focused and allied branches of Engineering, Technology, Applied Sciences and Management Studies. Its address is Deoghat Jhalwa, Prayagraj-211015 (U.P.). This notice is issued by its Establishment Section.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The complete application with all relevant supporting documents, duly self-attested, must be submitted by hand to: Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, Admin. Extension Block-I, West Wing, IIIT Allahabad. Last date and time: 15 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. Envelope: superscribe it with: Application for the post of "_____" (as applicable) (Promotional Vacancy) – Advt. No.: Estt./PR-NT/04/2026 dated 19.11.2026. Form: the notice encloses the "Application for IIIT-A Non-Teaching Employees". Candidates must complete it and attach all relevant, self-attested supporting documents. The completed application must be duly forwarded by the Head/Section in-charge. After submission, the applicant should retain a copy of the submitted application. The form asks for the post applied for, name, marital status, name of father/husband, present and permanent address, e-mail and telephone, date of birth, nationality, date of joining at IIIT-Allahabad and in the present designation, whether upgraded under MACP (with date and grade), category (SC, ST, OBC, GEN, PH), academic record from secondary education, and past employment with pay and scale of pay.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The posts are to be filled on a promotional basis. The notice invites suitable internal candidates. Essential qualification with experience: Degree/Diploma in Engineering with 06 years of experience as Jr. Engineer in PB-2 with GP-4200 (Pay Matrix Level-6 as per 7th CPC). Essential qualification with experience: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA with 05 years of experience as Jr. Technical Superintendent in PB-2 with GP-4200 (Pay Matrix Level 6 as per 7th CPC). 08 years of experience for those not meeting the educational criteria for Jr. Technical Superintendent. Essential qualification with experience: 05 years of experience as Jr. Superintendent in PB-2 with GP-4200 (Pay Matrix Level 6 as per 7th CPC). The notice prints no separate educational qualification for this post. For posts 1 to 3 the notice says: "Age limit prescribed for the posts not applicable for regular employees of IIIT Allahabad." No age figure is printed. Eligibility in every respect is determined as on the normal closing date, 15 December 2026, 05:00 PM. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The completed application form, forwarded by the Head/Section in-charge. All relevant supporting documents, self-attested, with details of qualifications and experience. Xerox copies of degree certificates (the form's academic record, item 11, asks for these). Attested copy of the Caste Certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India, for SC/ST and OBC-NCL candidates. The form says the caste certificate must be issued by an authorised officer only.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised first, and only scrutiny-cleared applicants are called for the selection process. The final selection is based on the candidate's performance in the written test and skill test, along with overall qualifications and experience. The screening and selection criteria follow RPN and the prevailing practice for promotional recruitment. Mere fulfilment of the stated qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the written test and skill test. The notice does not give a test pattern, syllabus or dates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 promotional vacancies: Assistant Engineer (Electrical) 1 (UR), Technical Superintendent 2 (1 UR, 1 SC) and Superintendent 1 (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The complete application must be submitted by hand on or before 15 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. Late applications are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice invites suitable internal candidates for appointment on promotional posts. The posts are filled on a promotional basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: A Degree/Diploma in Engineering with 06 years of experience as Jr. Engineer in PB-2 with GP-4200 (Pay Matrix Level-6 as per 7th CPC).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Technical Superintendent and Superintendent?
faq.answer: Technical Superintendent needs B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA with 05 years as Jr. Technical Superintendent (08 years for those not meeting the educational criteria). Superintendent needs 05 years of experience as Jr. Superintendent.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an age limit?
faq.answer: The notice says the age limit prescribed for the posts is not applicable for regular employees of IIIT Allahabad. No age figure is printed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: All three posts carry Pay Matrix Level-7 as per the 7th CPC. The notice prints no rupee amount.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the enclosed application form, attach self-attested supporting documents and have it forwarded by the Head/Section in-charge. Submit it by hand to the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, Admin. Extension Block-I, West Wing, IIIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write: Application for the post of "_____" (as applicable) (Promotional Vacancy) – Advt. No.: Estt./PR-NT/04/2026 dated 19.11.2026.

faq.question: Q10. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the written test and skill test, along with overall qualifications and experience. Only scrutiny-cleared applicants are called for the selection process.
